name: plasticity/compress
description: Compress a model using utilization-aware head pruning + mixed quantization. Takes a base model + gradient capture data + target device spec, produces an optimized GGUF file that fits the device's memory budget. Precision is allocated per-tensor based on head utilization scores.

params.name: capturePath
params.description: Path to gradient capture directory (containing head_topology.json from plasticity/analyze)

params.name: modelPath
params.description: Path to base model safetensors directory (or HuggingFace model ID)

params.name: deviceSpec
params.description: Target device: '16gb', '32gb', '24gb-vram', '5090', 'macbookair', 'macbookpro', or JSON DeviceSpec. Default: '32gb'

params.name: architecture
params.description: Model architecture: 'qwen2', 'llama'. Auto-detected from config.json if not specified.

results.name: ggufPath
results.description: Path to the output compressed GGUF file

results.name: quantDistribution
results.description: Count of tensors at each quantization level

results.name: verified
results.description: Whether the output passed verification (NaN check, dimension check)

examples.description: Compress a 14B model for MacBook Air 16GB
